name: Sunny Park
source:
Vesper's resident psychologist and a lifelong friend of Leslie, Sunny has a disposition as bright as her name. She loves understanding the deeper motivations behind people's actions and will sometimes try unorthodox methods of mental examination to learn more.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
